main_text.l: Argumenta contra Meritum de Condigno, ex Patrum antiquorum testimoniis lo-cupletissimis desumpta.
ritum de Condigno, ex parte Operis boni, ut est Dei Donum.
ad salutem æternam, est Dei Donum:
conferens ad salutem æternam, potest esse proprie Me-

page.notes: The running head is faint and partly obscured; read as ANTIDOTUM with doubt. A faint "74" appears at the top right, above the blank right-hand area; it is likely show-through or a faint number from the facing page and is not transcribed. The first line of text at the bottom is only partly visible and too faint to read beyond its first words. The top line is a fragment: only its lower part is visible, so the heading is given as far as it can be read. The top of the page is cut off, so the first line may be incomplete. Show-through and the edge of the neighbouring page are left out.
